title: Number of 1 Bits
constraints: The input must be a binary string of length 32
description: Write a function that takes the binary representation of a positive integer and returns the number of set bits (i.e., '1'-bits) it has.

tests.explanation: 11 in binary is 1011, which has three 1-bits.
128 in binary is 10000000, which has one 1-bit.
